secondary_signals.title: 美國與全球股市
secondary_signals.what_happened: Slatestone Wealth Partner and Chief Market Strategist Kenny Polcari fills in for Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi on Sozzi Unleashed to explain why the latest market pullback is a far cry from a repeat of the 1987 Black Monday crash. After the Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) dropped roughly 4% and the S&P 500 (^GSPC) slid about 2% last week, bargain hunters stepped in to buy the dip. Polcari breaks down why the recent volatility may signal a rotation out of certain sectors rather than a broader market meltdown, and what investors should watch next。
